title: ChromSMF: integrated profiling of histone modifications, protein-DNA interactions and DNA methylation on multi-kilobase DNA molecules
one_liner_zh: 该文开发ChromSMF方法，在单分子水平同时测量组蛋白修饰、TF结合与DNA甲基化，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但以实验技术为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，对TF-DNA互作机制研究仅有间接参考价值。
abstract: Chromatin accessibility and histone post-translational modifications are widely used to identify and characterize cis -regulatory elements. Yet, these are typically measured separately, precluding direct linkage between them. Here, we present Chromatin-informed Single Molecule Footprinting (ChromSMF), a method that simultaneously quantifies histone modifications, transcription factor binding, and nucleosome occupancy, while measuring DNA methylation and sequence variations on the same multi-kilobase DNA molecules. ChromSMF combines antibody-guided tethering of the adenine methyltransferase Hia5 to modified histones, protein-DNA footprinting using the cytosine methyltransferase M.CviPI, and direct methylation detection by Nanopore sequencing. We benchmark ChromSMF across five histone modifications, uncovering relationships between epigenetic states and chromatin opening across entire cis -regulatory landscapes. We further present a computational framework for integrated analysis of multiple layers of epigenetic regulation on individual haplotypes. Together, ChromSMF provides an integrated genome-wide genomic method to investigate the combinatorial function of multiple genetic and epigenetic factors on gene regulation across diverse cellular contexts.
abstract_zh: 染色质可及性和组蛋白翻译后修饰被广泛用于识别和表征顺式调控元件。然而，这些通常被分别测量，阻碍了它们之间的直接关联。在此，我们提出染色质信息引导的单分子足迹分析（Chromatin-informed Single Molecule Footprinting, ChromSMF），这是一种同时量化组蛋白修饰、转录因子结合和核小体占据的方法，并在同一多千碱基DNA分子上测量DNA甲基化和序列变异。ChromSMF结合了抗体引导的腺嘌呤甲基转移酶Hia5与修饰组蛋白的锚定、使用胞嘧啶甲基转移酶M.CviPI进行的蛋白质-DNA足迹分析，以及通过纳米孔测序直接检测甲基化。我们在五种组蛋白修饰上对ChromSMF进行了基准测试，揭示了整个顺式调控景观中表观遗传状态与染色质开放之间的关系。我们进一步提出了一个计算框架，用于在单个单倍型上综合分析多层表观遗传调控。总之，ChromSMF提供了一种整合的全基因组方法，用于研究多种遗传和表观遗传因素在不同细胞环境中对基因调控的组合功能。
